sets.title: Which Particle?
sets.description: Choose -то, -нибудь, or кое- for each context
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите -то, -нибудь или кое- для каждого контекста

items.prompt: _____ оставил сумку на стуле. (Someone left a bag on the chair. - I see the bag but don't know who.)
items.promptEnglish: Someone left a bag on the chair.
items.hint: A specific person did it, but I don't know who = -то.
items.explanation: Specific unknown person: кто-то (someone, I don't know who).

items.prompt: Ты _____ видел интересное сегодня? (Did you see anything interesting today?)
items.promptEnglish: Did you see anything interesting today?
items.explanation: In questions, -нибудь means 'anything at all': что-нибудь.

items.prompt: Я хочу тебе _____ рассказать. (I want to tell you something. - I know what.)
items.promptEnglish: I want to tell you something (and I know exactly what).
items.explanation: Speaker knows the specific thing: кое-что.

items.prompt: Если _____ позвонит, скажи, что я скоро вернусь. (If anyone calls, say I'll be back soon.)
items.promptEnglish: If anyone calls, say I'll be back soon.
items.explanation: Hypothetical in conditional: кто-нибудь (if anyone at all).

items.prompt: На столе лежит _____ письмо. (There's some letter on the table. - I see it but don't know what it is.)
items.promptEnglish: There's some kind of letter on the table.
items.explanation: I can see the letter but don't know what kind: какое-то (some kind of).

items.prompt: Купи мне _____ сок, любой. (Buy me some juice, any kind.)
items.promptEnglish: Buy me some juice, any kind.
items.hint: Any at all, I don't care which = -нибудь.
items.explanation: Any kind will do: какой-нибудь (any whatsoever).

items.prompt: У меня есть _____ идея. (I have a certain idea. - I know what it is.)
items.promptEnglish: I have a certain idea (I know what it is, teasing).
items.hint: I know the specific idea = кое-.
items.explanation: Known to the speaker, withheld from listener: кое-какая.

minimalPairs.context: _____ звонил тебе утром. (past event, specific unknown)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Someone called you this morning. (it happened, I don't know who)
minimalPairs.explanation: Past, factual event: кто-то (someone specific but unknown to me).

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Did anyone call you today? (asking if it happened at all)
minimalPairs.explanation: Question checking if anyone at all called: кто-нибудь.

minimalPairs.context: Мне нужно _____ сказать тебе. (I know what I need to say.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I need to tell you something. (I have something specific in mind.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Speaker knows specifically what: кое-что. Creates suspense/teasing.

minimalPairs.context: _____ случилось, но я не знаю что. (Something happened, I don't know what.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Something happened, but I don't know what.
minimalPairs.explanation: Speaker doesn't know what happened: что-то (something unknown).

sets.title: Context Sort
sets.description: Sort by which particle fits and fill in blanks
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте по частице и заполните пропуски

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: Which particle does each context require?

items.word: В комнате кто-... разговаривает. (I hear someone.)
Дай мне что-... почитать. (Give me anything to read.)
Я знаю кое-... о нём. (I know something about him.)
Если что-... будет нужно, скажи. (If you need anything...)
Что-... упало в соседней комнате. (Something fell.)
Кое-... хочет с тобой познакомиться. (A certain someone wants to meet you.)
Ты когда-... был в Японии? (Have you ever been?)
Где-... я это уже видел. (I've seen this somewhere.)
У меня есть кое-... дела. (I have some business.)

blanks: Завтра приготовь _____. Мне всё равно что. (Cook something tomorrow. I don't care what.)
На улице _____ кричит. Интересно, что случилось? (Someone is shouting outside.)
У меня есть _____ новости для тебя! (I have some news for you! - I know what.)
Ты _____ был за границей? (Have you ever been abroad?)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: -нибудь for any/hypothetical, -то for specific unknown, кое- for known to speaker
hints: Any food, I don't care which.
Someone specific is shouting, I don't know who.
I know what the news is.
explanations: Specific unknown person: кто-то (I hear them).
Known to speaker: кое-какие (I know what news).

sets.title: Fix and Build
sets.description: Fix wrong particle choices and build sentences
sets.descriptionRussian: Исправьте ошибки в частицах и постройте предложения

errorCorrection.hint: Past fact (someone actually did it) = -то, not -нибудь.
errorCorrection.explanation: A factual past event needs -то: Кто-то оставил (someone actually left it).
Conditional uses -нибудь: если что-нибудь случится (if anything at all happens).

errorCorrection.sentence: У тебя есть что-нибудь интересное рассказать? Я знаю, что есть!
errorCorrection.hint: The second sentence shows the speaker knows what. Known = кое-.
errorCorrection.explanation: The speaker knows the specific thing: кое-что (not что-нибудь which means 'anything').

errorCorrection.sentence: Дай мне кое-что почитать, мне всё равно что.
errorCorrection.hint: 'I don't care what' = any at all = -нибудь. Кое- means the speaker has something specific.
errorCorrection.explanation: Any at all (I don't care which): что-нибудь. Кое-что would mean a specific thing.

translation.english: Someone is knocking on the door.
translation.hint: I hear the knocking, specific person, I don't know who = кто-то

translation.english: Do you want anything to drink?
I know a certain something about this.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All three particles in varied contexts
sets.descriptionRussian: Все три частицы в разных контекстах

items.prompt: Мне _____ звонили, пока меня не было? (Did anyone call me while I was out?)
items.promptEnglish: Did anyone call me while I was away?
items.explanation: Question checking: кто-нибудь (did anyone at all call?).

items.prompt: Я _____ забыл, но не помню что. (I forgot something, but I can't remember what.)
items.promptEnglish: I forgot something, but I can't remember what.
items.hint: Something specific was forgotten, but I don't know what = -то.
items.explanation: Specific but unknown to me: что-то (I know I forgot something, but what?).

items.prompt: У него есть _____ план. Он расскажет завтра. (He has a certain plan. He'll tell us tomorrow.)
items.promptEnglish: He has a certain plan. He'll share it tomorrow.
items.hint: He knows the plan, it's specific to him = кое-.
items.explanation: Known to the subject: кое-какой (a particular plan he has in mind).

items.prompt: Поедем летом _____? (Shall we go somewhere in summer? - any place)
items.promptEnglish: Shall we go somewhere this summer? (anywhere at all)
items.hint: Suggestion for the future, any place = -нибудь.

items.prompt: Я _____ положил ключи и не могу найти. (I put the keys somewhere and can't find them.)
items.promptEnglish: I put the keys somewhere and can't find them.
items.hint: I put them in a specific place, but I forgot where = -то.
items.explanation: Specific unknown place (past fact): куда-то (somewhere, I don't remember where).

items.prompt: Which particle would you use in: 'If you need anything, let me know'?
items.promptEnglish: Which particle fits a conditional 'if anything' context?
items.explanation: Conditional/hypothetical uses -нибудь: если что-нибудь нужно. (-либо is a formal written variant of -нибудь.)

patternRecognition.sentence: кто-то, что-то, где-то, когда-то, куда-то, как-то
patternRecognition.question: In what type of context are -то forms used?
options: Past/present facts where the specific detail is unknown to the speaker
When the speaker knows the detail but withholds it
patternRecognition.answer: Past/present facts where the specific detail is unknown to the speaker
patternRecognition.explanation: -то marks something specific that exists or happened, but the speaker doesn't know the details.

patternRecognition.question: In what type of context are -нибудь forms used?
options: Questions, offers, conditionals, future possibilities, requests
When the speaker knows the answer
patternRecognition.answer: Questions, offers, conditionals, future possibilities, requests
patternRecognition.explanation: -нибудь appears in non-factual contexts: questions, offers, conditionals, and future hypotheticals.

blanks: Он _____ живёт далеко отсюда. Адреса не знаю. (He lives somewhere far from here.)
Поедем _____? Мне не важно куда. (Shall we go somewhere? I don't care where.)
hints: He actually lives there (fact), I don't know where exactly.
Suggestion for the future, any destination.
explanations: Factual but unknown detail: где-то (somewhere, I don't know where).
